candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; inventory/redis calls succeed, so the fault is downstream payment latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; payment latency inferred from client-side ReadTimeout spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated ReadTimeout transport errors on POST payment /v1/authorizations (~2s), propagating to order and gateway /v1/checkout 502s, while inventory/redis reservations return 200. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->payment dependency. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
